sourcing.agency: Water Resources Department (WRD), Government of Tamil Nadu
sourcing.reference: CWC National Register of Large Dams (NRLD 2023), TN WRD Lower Bhavani Project Compendium

dams.dataNotes: CWC NRLD registers total crest length as 8,797 m (465 m masonry spillway + 8,332 m earthen dykes), making it one of the longest earthen dams in the world. Height above deepest foundation is 40.0 m (max water depth ~32 m / 105 ft FRL). Gross storage capacity verified at 32.80 TMC (928.8 MCM). Fully wired for live hydrodynamic simulation in this system.

dams.dataNotes: STRUCTURAL HEIGHT VS RIVERBED HEIGHT FLAG: Total height above lowest foundation is 65.2 m (214 ft); height above riverbed / FRL sill is 36.58 m (120.0 ft). dams.dataNotes: CRITICAL DUAL-STATE JURISDICTION & CAPACITY CONFLICT: Located physically in Peermade Taluk, Idukki District, Kerala, but operated and maintained by Tamil Nadu PWD under a 999-year lease signed in 1886. Design gross capacity at 152.0 ft FRL is 15.66 TMC (443.2 MCM). Following Supreme Court 2014 judgment, permissible water level is capped at 142.0 ft, yielding operational storage of 10.56 TMC (299.1 MCM). Both figures documented.
dams.dualStateDetails: Location: Idukki District, Kerala. Operator: Government of Tamil Nadu (under 1886 lease agreement). Water diverted east into Vaigai Basin for 5 southern TN districts.

dams.name: Idukki Dam
dams.nearestCity: Cheruthoni (1 km) / Thodupuzha (55 km) / Kochi (110 km)
dams.damType: Double-curvature parabolic concrete thin arch dam

sourcing.agency: Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB)
sourcing.reference: CWC National Register of Large Dams, KSEB Hydro-Electric Project Compendium

dams.dataNotes: STRUCTURAL CONFIGURATION NOTE: Idukki Dam is one of the highest arch dams in Asia (168.91 m height above foundation) and has no spillway gates on the arch structure itself. Discharges are handled through the adjacent Cheruthoni concrete gravity spillway dam (138.2 m height, 651 m length) and Kulamavu masonry dam (100 m height). Impounds a contiguous reservoir of 1,996 MCM.

dams.dataNotes: Height above lowest foundation is 102.8 m (337 ft); crest length is 373 m. Gross capacity is 1,089.8 MCM (38.48 TMC); live storage capacity is 1,017.8 MCM (35.94 TMC). Critical for releasing counter-head freshwater to prevent Arabian Sea tidal salinity intrusion into Kochi municipal water intakes during summer months.

dams.dataNotes: MAJOR UNIT CONVERSION CONFLICT RESOLVED: Several online tourism portals report dam height as '115.06 m', which is an incorrect transcription of 115.06 FEET. Official CWC NRLD registers the true structural height above deepest foundation as 38.10 m (125.0 ft). Longest dam in Kerala at 2,069 m total length. Gross capacity: 226.0 MCM (7.98 TMC).

dams.name: Tungabhadra Dam
dams.nearestCity: Hosapete (Hospet - 5 km) / Ballari (70 km)
dams.damType: Composite (Rubble masonry gravity dam 1,770 m + Earthen dykes 679 m)

sourcing.agency: Tungabhadra Board (Joint body of GoI, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh)
sourcing.reference: Tungabhadra Board Master Plan, CWC NRLD, CWC Hydrographic Sedimentation Survey 2020

dams.dataNotes: CRITICAL SILTATION CONFLICT FLAGGED: Original 1953 design gross capacity was 132.47 TMC (3,751 MCM). Extensive hydrographic and satellite bathymetry surveys by CWC confirm sediment deposition of ~31.6 TMC, reducing live storage to ~100.86 TMC (2,857 MCM). In August 2024, chain link failure on crest gate #19 triggered emergency discharges, demonstrating extreme downstream risk.

dams.nearestCity: Almatti / Nidagundi / Bagalkote (35 km) / Vijayapura (65 km)

sourcing.agency: Krishna Bhagya Jala Nigam Limited (KBJNL), Government of Karnataka
sourcing.reference: CWC National Register of Large Dams, Krishna Water Disputes Tribunal (KWDT-II) Records

dams.dataNotes: LEGAL FRL DISCREPANCY FLAGGED: Present operating FRL is 519.60 m MSL, corresponding to gross storage of 123.08 TMC (3,485.4 MCM). The Krishna Water Disputes Tribunal (KWDT-II) approved raising FRL to 524.256 m MSL (which will expand capacity to 227 TMC), but final statutory gazetting remains stayed pending inter-state supreme court proceedings. Current verified capacity: 123.08 TMC.

dams.dataNotes: INTER-STATE OPERATIONAL DIVISION FLAGGED: Right bank powerhouse (770 MW) and Pothireddypadu Head Regulator are operated by Andhra Pradesh; Left bank underground powerhouse (900 MW) is operated by Telangana. Gross capacity at FRL 885.0 ft (269.75 m) is 216.0 TMC (6,116 MCM); active live storage is ~178.7 TMC. Structural height is 145.10 m (476 ft).

dams.name: Nagarjuna Sagar Dam
dams.district: Palnadu (AP Right Bank) / Nalgonda (TG Left Bank)
dams.nearestCity: Macherla (25 km) / Guntur (145 km) / Hyderabad (150 km)

sourcing.agency: Water Resources Department AP / Irrigation TG / Krishna River Management Board
sourcing.reference: CWC National Register of Large Dams, KRMB Water Accounting Manual

dams.dataNotes: STRUCTURAL RECORD & SEDIMENTATION NOTE: World's tallest and largest masonry dam at 124.0 m structural height. Total length: 1,550 m (masonry portion 1,450 m, plus 3.4 km earth saddle dykes). Design gross capacity is 405.13 TMC (11,472 MCM). Siltation surveys estimate ~50 TMC of dead silt accumulation over 55+ years, but original design capacity remains official NRLD benchmark.

dams.dataNotes: Largest storage reservoir in the Penna River basin with gross storage of 78.0 TMC (2,208 MCM) at FRL 100.58 m MSL. Receives supplementary inflows from Krishna basin via Srisailam Right Main Canal (SRMC) and Banakacherla Cross Regulator, connecting Krishna and Penna basins.

dams.name: Prakasam Barrage
dams.nearestCity: Vijayawada (at center of city) / Amaravati (20 km) / Guntur (35 km)
dams.damType: Gated regulator barrage with road bridge (Low-head diversion structure)

sourcing.agency: Water Resources Department (WRD), Government of Andhra Pradesh
sourcing.reference: CWC NRLD 2023, Andhra Pradesh Delta Irrigation Division, Krishna Barrage Records

dams.dataNotes: STRUCTURAL CLASSIFICATION NOTE FLAGGED: Unlike high-head storage dams, Prakasam Barrage is a low-head barrage/diversion regulator (12.0 m height of gate structure above downstream apron, 1,223.5 m length with 70 crest gates of 12.19 m span each). Pondage capacity is only 3.07 TMC (86.9 MCM). Included in CWC NRLD as a specified large hydraulic structure due to its critical role as the control valve of the entire Krishna Delta and extreme vulnerability to upstream surges from Srisailam/Nagarjuna Sagar.
